I have been farming beans on this same half-hectare plot for many years, and I know the soil here is getting tired. I will put down a small amount of the government NPK fertilizer because my nephew helped me get it from the agro-dealer, but I do not need too much nitrogen since beans bring their own. I will also spread cow manure from my compound because it keeps the soil soft when the rains stop. I am using the seeds I kept from last season’s harvest, and I must buy one or two bottles of spray because the pod borers here will destroy everything if I do not.
